title: Potatoism Practice Path

derived.name: Efficiency
derived.meaning: Use less unnecessary effort while preserving useful growth.

derived.name: Iteration
derived.meaning: Repeat the cycle with more information and less needless complexity.

derived.name: Nourishment
derived.meaning: Growth matures when it becomes useful beyond the self.

derived.name: Cultivation
derived.meaning: Improve conditions so good growth becomes easier.

derived.name: Seed of light
derived.meaning: Protect one small viable source of clarity, care, truth, beauty or understanding and help it grow.

cycle: observe -> simplify -> orient -> act -> notice results -> integrate -> simplify again
daily: Choose one direction toward greater clarity or life
